name: Big Blue Button
description: Integrates BigBlueButton web conferencing into Drupal as a single-cardinality field; API calls are signed with the BBB shared secret via the bigbluebutton/bigbluebutton-api-php library.

suggests.token: Token replacement in the welcome message, moderator-only message, logout URL and display name.
suggests.rest: Core REST module is required to expose the join-meeting-link and meeting-info REST resources.

project_description:
BigBlueButton is an open source web conferencing system. In addition to various web conferencing services, it has integrations for many of the major learning and content management systems. This module integrates BigBlueButton as a easy to configure field to Drupal.

 Features 
 
 Breakout rooms (Guest policy) 
 Auto record meetings 
 Auto mute meetings 
 Define welcome messages for viewers and moderators 
 Upload Presentations through general settings 
 The field can detect fields from type file and can map those to upload presentations 
 
 Post-Installation 
 After you have installed this module please visit the config page and enter your BBB Host and BBB Secret. Upload a presentation default if you like.

 Additional Requirements 
 This module will install the BBB PHP Library automatically for you. There is no other dependency.

 Recommended modules/libraries 
 There will be support for group module and registration.
